resolved_findings.title: Saving a key reported success when the sidecar restart returned failed
resolved_findings.first_evidence: Before the fix, the save handler discarded controller.restart()'s {state:'failed',errorCode:'CONTENT_ENGINE_STOP_TIMEOUT'} and returned {configured:true}. An offline RSA handshake and stub-controller reproduction confirmed it.
resolved_findings.resolution: The caller now requires restarted.state === 'ready' and otherwise returns VOLCENGINE_TTS_RESTART_REQUIRED while preserving the already-saved key.
resolved_findings.validation: Repeated the same offline stub against the updated file: expected VOLCENGINE_TTS_RESTART_REQUIRED, one store write, zero network calls.

coverage.scope: Explicit bounded independent review of the new Volcengine TTS adapter, encrypted-key main/preload/IPC route, voice provider catalog/dispatch, and a quick music preview boundary check. Unrelated dirty work ignored.
confirmed_boundaries: Provider endpoint and model/voice routing follow the official ByteDance SSE contract; PCM is requested and wrapped as mono 16-bit 24 kHz WAV.
Only valid code 0 audio is accumulated; terminal code 20000000 is required. Malformed/truncated/transport-unknown responses do not publish output.
TTS provider makes a single request and preserves unknown outcome in the domain artifact lifecycle; no automatic resubmission path found.
API key stays encrypted on disk under Electron safeStorage and is injected into the private child environment; renderer receives status/masked suffix, encrypted IPC input only.
Voice candidates remain pending user audition/approval; missing-account state fails before a provider request.
Music preview validates the managed source digest/path and calls FFmpeg without a shell.
validation: Read-only source tracing across provider, domain/cache, IPC/preload and sidecar environment boundaries.
Offline RSA/key-save handler reproduction before and after caller's restart-state fix.
Earlier bounded adapter protocol checks covered successful PCM/WAV framing, terminal omission, rejected provider code, and no-account preflight.
limitations: No Volcengine account, API calls, billing or actual voice/listening verification.
No new music license or user-audition acceptance claim.
No packaged-runtime or complete application build verification by this reviewer; caller owns those checks.
This is a bounded single independent review under the caller's parallel workflow, not the full multi-persona or cross-model ce-code-review pipeline.
No broad review of unrelated dirty workspace changes.
